subject: Commit bucket harmonization and channel margin reconciliation for CloudBridge private offers
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudbridge.com
Date: 2026-05-10T14:12:00Z
Subject: Private offer buckets — need to reconcile channel passback matching

Hi Olga / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and our Channel Ops team reviewed the private offer you're proposing for our multi-region commitment. Two quick asks before we can move to legal:

1) We see the commit buckets differ between AWS and GCP SKUs — can you provide a consolidated commit matrix that shows equivalent tiers for list-price aggregation? We need this to feed into our chargeback model.
2) Channel passback: our reseller needs a clear waterfall — what percentage flows at each commit tranche and how do overages get credited back?

Attached is the preliminary SOW from our side (not legal final). Can you return a single table (CSV/xlsx) that maps vendor SKUs -> commitment buckets -> reseller passback?

Timing: we need this by EOD Wednesday (2026-05-13) to keep the procurement window.

Regards,
Elena Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Cloud Procurement
CloudBridge

[Attachment: CB_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Private offer buckets — need to reconcile channel passback matching

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask. Ben and I dug in and put together a harmonized commit matrix and the expected passback waterfall. High level:

- We normalized AWS/GCP/Azure SKU families into three commit bands (Bronze/ Silver/ Gold) with explicit USD thresholds to avoid currency/sku mismatch.
- Reseller passback is tiered: 6% at Bronze, 4% at Silver, 2% at Gold (applies to net ARR credited to list-price). Overages above committed volume are credited at a fixed 1.5% retrospective rebate.
- For multi-region footprints, we apply a geo-harmonization factor so regional list prices are converted to a single USD-equivalent commit bucket — see matrix.

I've attached: Redwood_commit_matrix.xlsx (maps SKUs -> buckets) and Passback_workflow_v2.pdf (flow diagram + waterfall examples).

Open questions for you:
- Do you need reseller invoices to flow through your distributor (vs direct passback)? That changes timing for the rebate (monthly vs quarter-end true-up).
- Any carveouts for pilot/POC credits that should be excluded from passback?

We can turn this into a single table you can drop into your chargeback model — Ben, can you add the revenue allocation column and tax-treatment notes?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Director, Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: Redwood_commit_matrix.xlsx (xlsx), Passback_workflow_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Private offer buckets — need to reconcile channel passback matching

Elena / Olga —

I updated the matrix with the revenue allocation and the holdback timing. Notes:

- Revenue allocation column added: shows list-price -> net-recognized mapping after distributor fees and standard tax withhold. This will help your chargeback model.
- Holdback / timing: If invoices route through your distributor, passback payments are processed at quarter true-up (standard) and can be netted monthly if you prefer faster cadence but with an admin fee.
- Pilot carveouts: propose marking pilot credits with a "pilot" flag; they are excluded from tranche calculations.

Action items we need from you to finalize the file:
1) Confirm whether distributor routing is required (yes/no).
2) Provide an example invoice or line-item so we can validate the mapping (if comfortable).

I'll also add an example waterfall for 3 common usage profiles (steady, spiky, seasonal) so your ops team can see cashflow impact.

-Ben
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: CloudBridge_PO_Draft_20260512.docx (docx) — draft with our suggested language]

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudbridge.com
Date: 2026-05-16T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Private offer buckets — need to reconcile channel passback matching

Olga / Ben —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. The matrix looks good and the waterfall examples are helpful. A few quick confirmations from our side:

- Distributor routing: YES — invoices will route via our distributor (ChannelOne). Please assume quarter true-up cadence.
- Pilot carveouts: confirmed — exclude any credits flagged as "pilot".
- Reseller requests one minor change to passback: they'd like the Bronze passback to be front-loaded (8% for the first 90 days, then 4% thereafter). Can you confirm whether you can accommodate that front-load window?

If we can get a short amendment to the PO doc with that front-load clause and a DocuSign link, legal will move quickly. We're aiming to sign by EOD Friday (2026-05-21) to align with our quarter planning.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Cloud Procurement
CloudBridge
